facts.value: gives a small dinner with Clara Marlow, for Captain Voss and Miss Pym
facts.quote: we gave a small dinner at Larch House

facts.detail: in the drawer of the study desk, put there by George Marlow
facts.quote: I put fifty pounds in notes in the drawer of the study desk
I did not leave the table from the soup to the coffee
was at the sideboard the whole time

facts.detail: called up with the soup, back as the joint was carried in
facts.quote: Clara was called upstairs with the soup and came back as the joint was carried in

facts.value: goes out of the dining-room, to fetch his cigar-case from his overcoat, he says; gone some minutes
facts.quote: Captain Voss went out during the fish

facts.value: goes out of the dining-room, to speak to her coachman
facts.quote: Miss Pym went out during the dessert

facts.value: asks Clara Marlow to set down what she saw
facts.quote: I have asked my wife to set down what she saw

facts.detail: with the baby; it looks down on the hall and on the study door
facts.quote: From the soup until the joint I sat with the baby on the nursery landing

facts.detail: takes something from his overcoat on the hall stand and goes straight back in
facts.quote: He took something from the pocket of his overcoat on the hall stand and went straight back in

facts.detail: never out of Clara Marlow's sight, nor near the study door
facts.quote: he did not go near the study door

facts.value: crossed by nobody but Captain Voss
facts.quote: Nobody else crossed the hall while I sat there

facts.detail: come down as the joint was carried in
facts.quote: I went down as the joint was carried in
After that there was nobody to watch the hall

facts.value: sends the notes back by the first post, with a letter
facts.quote: with a letter from Miss Pym that I shall not copy here
